How do I use it properly the very first time?
Message from AI Agent:
For your first brew, here’s a simple French press process: 
Heat fresh water to 200°F.
Preheat the French Press with hot water, then let it sit briefly.
Measure 55 grams of freshly roasted coffee beans—about 5½ coffee scoops or 11 tablespoons if you don’t have a scale—and grind them to a coarse sea salt consistency.
Pour out the preheating water and add the coffee grounds.
Add about 110 grams of hot water to saturate the grounds. Give the French Press a quick swirl and wait 30 seconds.
Continue adding hot water until the scale reaches 880 grams, or the water reaches the middle of the metal band, about 1 inch below the rim.
Place the plunger on top, slowly press it halfway down, and pull it back up to just below the surface. Set a timer for 3 minutes.
When the timer ends, press the plunger all the way to the bottom and serve the coffee.
The full process takes about 5 minutes and is rated Easy. For your first attempt, the most important things are using a coarse grind, water at the right temperature, and timing the brew carefully.
